title: Admin Console browser API
description: Closed browser DTOs for the Admin Console BFF routes declared in admin-contract.json. Requests are JSON bodies for JSON routes, the parsed form for multipart uploads and the parsed query/path object for bodyless routes.

model.description: Opaque model specification owned by Agent Controller; the Console validates and forwards it unchanged.
